frases.alumno: Backing the thesis with empirical evidence gives the text persuasive strength.

texto: Vocabulary for writing academic essays, the architecture of argumentative texts and the articulation of a thesis: «ข้อโต้แย้ง» (khɔ̂ɔ-dtôo-yɛ̂ɛng, counter-argument / dialectical objection), «ย่อหน้า» (yɔ̂ɔ-nâa, paragraph / compositional section), «สนับสนุน» (sà-nàp-sà-nǔn, to support / to back up with evidence) and «หักล้าง» (hàk-láang, to refute / to rebut with arguments). To state the core thesis use «ประเด็นสำคัญคือ...» (the central issue is...). To contrast the reach of evidence: «หลักฐานนี้สนับสนุนข้อโต้แย้ง แต่ยังไม่หักล้างทุกข้อสงสัย» (this evidence supports the objection, but does not refute every doubt). For measured concluding transitions: «อย่างไรก็ดี...» (however / nevertheless...).
